About

.01

Our vision

Driven by the ambition to reach new horizons, Kouklas Marble strives to strengthen its presence in the global marble industry, embracing greater challenges and more ambitious projects. Through an unwavering commitment to quality, we aim to exceed expectations, cultivate lasting trust, and pursue excellence without compromise.

.02

Our company

Rooted in decades of expertise, Kouklas Marble brings together the timeless artistry of natural stone and the precision of modern innovation. Guided by an appreciation for nature’s finest materials, we combine advanced technology with meticulous craftsmanship to ensure excellence in every detail.

Our longstanding relationships with quarries around the world allow us to source distinctive stones and maintain an extensive collection, bringing timeless beauty and enduring value to projects worldwide.

.03

Our facilities

Our facilities cover a total area of 20,000 m², which hosts our head offices and production departments.

20,000 m2total area in Xanthi
40+years of experience
.04

Our machinery

Aiming to achieve top quality and precision, we work with world class Italian machinery and properly trained & experienced personnel in order to ensure excellent craftsmanship and quality.
